# VX SDK (vx3) - LLM Documentation Index

This file is an index of documents under `docs/llm` intended to be easily referenced by LLMs and document search agents.
The documents describe the SDK on the `dev` branch of https://github.com/nk4dev/vx (npm package: `vx3`).

- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nk4dev/vx3/refs/heads/master/docs/llm/overview.md:
  - Project overview, purpose, and core features
  - Developer information (Maintainer: @nk4dev) and related URLs
  - License (SDK: MIT, parent monorepo: Apache-2.0)
  - Programming languages (TypeScript, JavaScript, Solidity)
  - Feature summary (scaffolding, local API server, real-time dashboard, payments, NFT minting, gas, IPFS, VXC compiler, React hooks, RPC config)
  - Bundled packages (`@vx3/vxc`, `@vx3/hardhat`, templates)

- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nk4dev/vx3/refs/heads/master/docs/llm/installation.md:
  - Requirements (Node.js 18+, Bun recommended)
  - Global / local installation (`npm install -g vx3`, `npm install vx3`)
  - One-off usage with `npx vx3` / `bunx vx3`
  - Build from source (`git clone -b dev`, `bun i`, `bun run build`, `bun link`)

- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nk4dev/vx3/refs/heads/master/docs/llm/commands.md:
  - Full CLI command list and flags
  - `vx.config.json` format and the `PRIVATE_KEY` environment variable
  - Key commands:
    - `vx3 init` / `vx3 create` (scaffold a project)
    - `vx3 rpc init | list` (RPC configuration)
    - `vx3 api` (local helper API server, port 8545; `--debug`) — replaces the old `vx3 serve` / `vx3 node`
    - `vx3 dash` (real-time dashboard, port 4000)
    - `vx3 gas`, `vx3 pay`, `vx3 nft mint`, `vx3 ipfs fetch`
    - `vx3 setup hardhat | react`, `vx3 generate template/<react|vue>`
    - `vx3 compile` (VXC Solidity compiler)
  - Endpoint tables, security notes, and best practices

- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nk4dev/vx3/refs/heads/master/docs/llm/usage.md:
  - ESM and CommonJS import examples (`import vx from 'vx3'`)
  - Config helpers (`vx3/core/config`, `VxConfigError`)
  - `getGasFees` return shape
  - Payment module (`payment.sendPayment`) and NFT minting (`mintNFT`)
  - IPFS fetch
  - React `<Payment />` (api / wallet modes) and hooks (`usePayment`, `usePaymentStatus`, `usePaymentDialog`)
  - Template generation and the VXC programmatic API

Search keywords (guidance for LLMs):
- vx3, vx3 init, vx3 create, vx3 rpc init, vx3 api --debug, vx3 dash, vx3 pay, vx3 gas, vx3 nft mint, vx3 compile, VXC
- Payment, NFT, ethers.js v6, Hardhat, Wallet, RPC configuration, vx.config.json, IPFS, SSE
- TypeScript, JavaScript, Solidity, React, Vue, Bun

Notes:
- Refer to each entry and extract detailed content from the corresponding document sections.
- When parsing, open `docs/llm/<file>.md` and prioritize sections such as "Overview", "Examples", and "CLI" for each file.
- `vx3 serve` and `@nk4dev/vx` are obsolete names; use `vx3 api` and the `vx3` package.
